items.title: Arbitrary Code Execution via Improper Output Encoding (Webhooks)
items.summary: An unauthenticated, zero-interaction vulnerability in the webhooks component of Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source could lead to arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: This vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source allows an attacker to upload malicious files, potentially leading to arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires user interaction.

items.title: SQL Injection leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A SQL Injection vulnerability in Adobe Commerce, Adobe Commerce B2B, and Magento Open Source could allow a high-privileged attacker to execute arbitrary code without user interaction.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: A stored XSS vulnerability in Adobe Commerce allows low-privileged attackers to inject malicious scripts into form fields, potentially leading to session hijacking or unauthorized actions.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could lead to security feature bypass.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization
items.summary: This incorrect authorization flaw in Adobe Commerce could grant unauthorized access to resources.

items.title: Cross-Site Scripting (Stored XSS)
items.summary: A stored XSS vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could allow an attacker to inject malicious scripts.

items.title: Improper Input Validation
items.summary: An improper input validation vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could lead to security issues.

items.title: Improper Input Validation
items.summary: This improper input validation vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could be exploited by an attacker.

items.title: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')
items.summary: An open redirect vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could redirect users to untrusted sites.

items.title: Information Exposure
items.summary: An information exposure vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could lead to the disclosure of sensitive information.

items.title: Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A security feature bypass vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could allow an attacker to circumvent security measures.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A stored XSS vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source could lead to arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Path Traversal leading to Arbitrary File System Write
items.summary: A path traversal vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source could allow an attacker to write arbitrary files to the file system.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source could allow an attacker to execute code remotely.
